<!--
Shape, not paperwork. Each section answers a question a reviewer would otherwise
have to ask, and the pull request is the only place the reasoning survives.

`Closes #<number>` on the first line is not optional: the `pr-guard` check fails
without it, and the branch must be named for the same issue.
-->

Closes #

## What changed

<!-- In the customer's terms. What is different for someone using the product,
     not a file-by-file diary. -->

## How it was verified

<!-- The command you ran and what it printed. `npm run verify` output, or the
     specific check suite, plus what you looked at in a browser and what size. -->

## Decisions and tradeoffs

<!-- What else was possible, why it was rejected, and what this costs. Anything
     that moved a number, a fee, a schema or an on-chain call says so here. -->

## Risk and rollback

<!-- What breaks if this is wrong, how it is undone, and whether a revert is
     enough or data has to be migrated back. -->

## Screenshots

<!-- For anything visual. A UI claim without a picture is unverified. Delete
     this section for a change with no surface. -->
